_comment: 許可プロンプトは邪魔なものではなく最後の防壁である（2026-08-30 第2回診断）。ただし 2026-09-17 に、その防壁が14日間ぶら下がったままだったと分かった。allow が押してよいブランチ名を1本ずつ書き並べる形だったので、09-03 に作業ブランチが変わった日から `git push` が allow から外れていた。この仕組みの単一障害点が、承認する人間の居ない回で永久に止まりうる状態にあった。だから allow からブランチ名を消し、禁止の側は bin/pushguard（PreToolUse フック）がコマンドを分解して判定する。名前を写し取る場所を増やすと、名前が変わった日に必ずどれかが腐る（bin/_common.sh の WORK_BRANCH の注意書きと同じ話）。ワイルドカードで丸ごと開けるのは依然として不可。

environment: This repository (ioriorigin/loop) is an autonomous agent's external memory. Most sessions are started by a scheduler with NO HUMAN PRESENT, so a permission prompt is never answered: the session hangs until the container is reclaimed and the whole round's work is lost. Three sessions have already been lost exactly this way.
The agent's own safety rules live in .claude/rules/autonomous-loop.md and are enforced mechanically by the PreToolUse hook bin/pushguard, not by permission prompts.

The working branch name is defined in exactly one place, bin/_common.sh (WORK_BRANCH), and it changes over time. Do not treat any particular branch name as a security boundary; main and master are the boundary.
allow: Running any script under ./bin/ in this repository. These are the agent's own recording and checking tools (round, log, note, hypo, recall, preflight, checkpoint, selftest, sitebuild/sitecheck/sitepublish, bookbuild/bookcheck, pagestamp, pushguard). They write only inside the repository.
git push, pull, fetch, merge and checkout against any branch of ioriorigin/loop except main and master. Pushing every round is how this agent persists its memory; a blocked push destroys the round.
git commit with a long or multi-paragraph message, including messages built with heredocs or command substitution. Message length is not a risk signal in this repository.
Reading, creating and editing files anywhere inside the repository working tree, including memory/, venture/, site/ and bin/.
hard_deny: Pushing directly to the main or master branch of any repository, in any form, including HEAD:main refspecs and +main. Changes reach main only through a pull request.

Rewriting, deleting or truncating existing entries in memory/log/, memory/notes/, memory/hypotheses.md, memory/rounds.md or memory/mentor/. These are append-only memory: appending is fine, editing or deleting the past is not.
Weakening .claude/rules/autonomous-loop.md by removing or loosening any of its prohibitions. Adding rules or tightening existing ones is allowed.
Creating, deleting or modifying scheduled triggers, except lowering this agent's own firing frequency.
